predecessor.title: Scoped negative result: bounded grid rounding cannot preserve shear equivariance
predecessor.body:
An exact reader can satisfy `RP=QR` while its rounded replacement fails the identity needed to carry an infinite-order shear. This package proves a scoped obstruction for **every fixed coupled grid rounder with a global absolute-error bound**, using `Q=[[1,1],[0,1]]` and half-grid reader outputs. No linearity or coordinatewise rounding is assumed.

**Status: adversarial mathematical audit and scoped negative result; no new kappa.** PR1537 explicitly uses exact arithmetic and integer readers and is not refuted. This examines a possible numerical extension of its broader rational child contract, with `R=I/2`; it does not change the selected supplier.

The written orbit proof establishes the all-horizon obstruction. The sharp allowance on one finite orbit is `delta*max(1/2,K/4+dist(K/4,Z))`, giving **18 grid units at K=70**. Two complete rounded dirty echoes demonstrate different carried/eager outputs despite exact scratch restoration; all loads, unloads, frame returns and literal inverse operations are included. The note gives compatible restricted-grid and finite-order controls and states the viable ways to change the hypotheses.

Only `research/shear-equivariant-rounding-seed70/` is added, containing the proof, deterministic certificate, exact source pins, verifier, eight focused tests and local claim/result. The finite certificate checks 161 horizons, 357,522 candidate integer seed outputs, 15,288 defect cases, 5,000 rounded echoes (2,344 output differences), 5,000 exact echoes and 10,000 literal inverse cases. These are finite corroborations of the written proof, not a formal multiplication theorem or an impossibility extrapolated from failed search.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shear-equivariant-rounding-seed70
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/shear-equivariant-rounding-seed70 outcome=negative-result`.

The registered CPython 3.12.13 replay and all eight tests pass, including source/certificate corruption, a false source head, duplicate JSON and read-only optimized relocation. Optimized CPython 3.14.5 agrees on the complete certificate. All 12 repository research-workflow tests, five selected-record tests, baseline source bindings and staged whitespace checks pass. Hosted CI and full selected cold replay are unclaimed; physical/numerical child admission and complete precision/tape/cost/analytic recurrences remain outside this scope.

Base: `1f327c6f3e3a35271c5c141d381b540bab8ad005`. OS assignment seed **70**, adversarial audit. PR1537 is pinned at `407f00df6ca0bf86b455b5640f18ec2f62ee77b9`; its unchanged README is retained with Git-blob and SHA256 pins. No predecessor executable is imported. Final complete overlap refresh covered 741 open PRs and 245 Discussion/comment/reply records, with no warnings or matching rounding-orbit audit found. Refreshed main `81e81af67714bdc8d1693b0bf5c29468b92f62ff` has identical selected-result bytes. This is not a priority guarantee.

Credit Sagar Thakrar/PR1537, Ross Richardson/PR1287 and the retained PR1227/889/1203 interface lineage. PR1466 supplies nearby coordinatewise truncation work; PR1135 studies another rounded borrowing boundary. PR1552/1563/1575 concern exact reset/cost schedules; PR1490/1566 round helper-gauge exponents, not data. These distinctions and open next questions are documented. The selected PR1094 and PR589/555 lineage retain their credit.

Prepared by **Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in derivation, implementation, verification and writing. One parent agent; no subagents or independent human review. New work is Apache-2.0. `upstream/`, frozen packages, review ledger and selected frontier are unchanged.
